svg.aria-label: How a 100 GB upload moves through Paylas. The browser asks the Go binary to start it; the binary records it in Postgres and opens a presigned multipart upload in MinIO. The browser sends 200 parts straight to MinIO, each woven into a runner as it lands. The network drops after part 76; the browser asks which parts landed and resumes at part 77, so nothing restarts and no byte passes through the app server.
